Shahi Tukda ek meetha khazana hai -  Ye ek rich aur creamy Indian mithai hai, aur hum aapse iski recipe share karne ke liye ready hain. Iske swadist elaichi aur kesar ke flavors ke saath, Shahi Tukda ek sach mein rich aur creamy mithai hai. Hum aapko step by step is shahi tukda ke recipe batayenge. transcript: Have you had the pleasure of enjoying Shahi Tukda at Delhi's Jama Masjid? If not then today we will learn how to make Shahi Tukda at home Pick a utensil for making this such as dish or glass container like this Accordingly, decide the number of breads to be fried Cut off corners of breads (optional) It's upto you whether to keep corners or not You may cut breads into pieces too First we will prepare sugar syrup 1/2 cup - sugar 1/2 cup - water Wait until it boils Make sugar syrup as same as used for Gulab Jamun Add 2 pods of cardamom for flavouring Use cardamom powder if you want instead Add few drops of Rose water/ Keora water Saffron colour Use saffron strands if it's available Using food colour is optional but... Authentic Shahi Tukda which is served in Jama Masjid has yellowish tint Boil the water some more Turn off gas flame once it assumes sticky consistency Leave it aside for cooling down Meanwhile, fry bread slices Heat oil in a pan Fry bread slices on medium high flame Add ghee too with oil so bread gets light ghee flavour You can fry, bake or roast bread slices as per your choice If you don't want to deep fry Or you can use toasted breads made using pop up toaster Since I am making authentic version of this recipe, I am deep frying bread slices Transfer slices into a plate Dip bread slices into sugar syrup Place them into glass container This is the ideal consistency of sugar syrup, it should not be too thick or too thin Let me know in comments why do you think it's called "Shahi Tukda" Also what are other names of this recipe? I will pin the most accurate comment Pour remaining syrup on top of arranged breads Bread slices should be soft yet crunchy, it shouldn't get soggy Keep it aside Let's make malai/cream 2 cups - milk Wait till it boils Once it boils, lower the gas flame Continue boiling it for some time Few saffron strands Cardamom powder Mix both into the milk 1/4th cup - sugar Add sugar powder or anything else if you want Mix and let it boil Lower gas flame as milk thickens 1/4th cup - milk powder 1 tbsp - corn flour Add milk and mix everything Create a thick mixture You can skip condensed milk or khoya since you are adding this mixture Slowly add mixture into milk and keep whisking all the while To keep lumps from forming into milk Cook until milk gets perfectly thick Its quite creamy and thick now It has coating consistency now Pour this cream/malai over bread slices You can create bread layer and then pour cream on top or add cream in between breads It's upto you, you can do this as per your taste It's evenly spread out Garnish with dry fruits, tuttie fruttie and anything else as per your taste Keep it in fridge for 1 hr to settle Usually it is enjoyed when it is fresh and warm Today, I will show how it looks and tastes after it's set 71 00:32,000 --> 00:08:34,000 It's perfectly set Pour ghee on top As I said earlier, authentic Shahi Tukda is served with dollops of ghee It looks beautiful, doesn't it? Do try this at home If you like this video then like, share and subscribe to the channel without fail Let's cut it into pieces Superb! It gets easily cut since we removed corners Remove it on a plate Super juicy, yummy and creamy! Super easy recipe too

transcript_segments.text: Have you had the pleasure of enjoying Shahi Tukda at Delhi's Jama Masjid?
If not then today we will learn how to make Shahi Tukda at home
Pick a utensil for making this such as dish or glass container like this
Accordingly, decide the number of breads to be fried
Cut off corners of breads (optional)
It's upto you whether to keep corners or not
You may cut breads into pieces too
First we will prepare sugar syrup
1/2 cup - sugar
1/2 cup - water
Wait until it boils
Make sugar syrup as same as used for Gulab Jamun
Add 2 pods of cardamom for flavouring
Use cardamom powder if you want instead
Add few drops of Rose water/ Keora water
Saffron colour
Use saffron strands if it's available
Using food colour is optional but...
Authentic Shahi Tukda which is served in Jama Masjid has yellowish tint
Boil the water some more
Turn off gas flame once it assumes sticky consistency
Leave it aside for cooling down
Meanwhile, fry bread slices
Heat oil in a pan
Fry bread slices on medium high flame
Add ghee too with oil so bread gets light ghee flavour
You can fry, bake or roast bread slices as per your choice
If you don't want to deep fry
Or you can use toasted breads made using pop up toaster
Since I am making authentic version of this recipe, I am deep frying bread slices
Transfer slices into a plate
Dip bread slices into sugar syrup
Place them into glass container
This is the ideal consistency of sugar syrup, it should not be too thick or too thin
Let me know in comments why do you think it's called "Shahi Tukda"
Also what are other names of this recipe?
I will pin the most accurate comment
Pour remaining syrup on top of arranged breads
Bread slices should be soft yet crunchy, it shouldn't get soggy
Keep it aside
Let's make malai/cream
2 cups - milk
Wait till it boils
Once it boils, lower the gas flame
Continue boiling it for some time
Few saffron strands
Cardamom powder
Mix both into the milk
1/4th cup - sugar
Add sugar powder or anything else if you want
Mix and let it boil
Lower gas flame as milk thickens
1/4th cup - milk powder
1 tbsp - corn flour
Add milk and mix everything
Create a thick mixture
You can skip condensed milk or khoya since you are adding this mixture
Slowly add mixture into milk and keep whisking all the while
To keep lumps from forming into milk
Cook until milk gets perfectly thick
Its quite creamy and thick now
It has coating consistency now
Pour this cream/malai over bread slices
You can create bread layer and then pour cream on top or add cream in between breads
It's upto you, you can do this as per your taste
It's evenly spread out
Garnish with dry fruits, tuttie fruttie and anything else as per your taste
Keep it in fridge for 1 hr to settle
Usually it is enjoyed when it is fresh and warm
Today, I will show how it looks and tastes after it's set 71 00:32,000 --> 00:08:34,000 It's perfectly set
Pour ghee on top
As I said earlier, authentic Shahi Tukda is served with dollops of ghee
It looks beautiful, doesn't it?
Do try this at home
If you like this video then like, share and subscribe to the channel without fail
Let's cut it into pieces
Superb!
It gets easily cut since we removed corners
Remove it on a plate
Super juicy, yummy and creamy!
Super easy recipe too
